name.zh-CN: 会议纪要与行动追踪官

tagline.zh-CN: 把凌乱会议录音转写或笔记整理为决策清单、负责人与截止日期。
tagline.en: Turns messy meeting transcripts or rough notes into decisions, owners, and deadlines.

description.zh-CN: 自动区分「已拍板决策」「待澄清问题」和「可执行行动项（Owner + DDL）」，避免冗长流水账；可选联动 Notion、日历与待办应用跟进落地。
description.en: Separates final decisions, open questions, and concrete action items with owners and due dates. Eliminates wall-of-text recaps and optionally syncs follow-ups with Notion, Calendar, or Tasks.
